Name: (CP) Long Haired Romanceable Wizard plus SVE Version
Author: aneemoia
Description:
Hello! This is my first mod so I am very excited!

This is a simple edit of Chaekal-Rizum's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3226?tab=description]wizard sprite[/url] for the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3073]Romanceable Rasmodius mod[/url]! It was edited to fit the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21822]Portrait of a Young Wizard[/url] mod by LT4823, because one day I suddenly decided I really needed to do this lol. I feel like the world needed a long haired handsome wizard.

[url=https://smapi.io]Smapi
[/url][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3073]Romanceable Rasmodius mod
[/url][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21822]Portrait of a Young Wizard[/url]﻿﻿ (Optional)

Compatibility:
Compatible with anything that doesn't affect the wizard's sprite.

UPDATE: 
I looked into the files for romanceable rasmodius's SVE compatible version, and looking between the sprites it seems that not much has changed. So using this with RR SVE should be compatible if you're looking to use it. If it doesn't work let me know and I'll look into it more. I don't use SVE personally so forgive the slow updates. 

How to install:
1. Download the file
2. Unzip the file
3. When you open the file you will see the [CP] Long Haired Romanceable Wizard ﻿
4. Drag that [CP] file to the mods folder in smapi
5. Have fun!
